annotations.title: utilpeek: live FX rates from Base stablecoin pools (EUR, GBP, MXN, BRL, CAD, SGD, ZAR, IDR) with ECB deviation, plus exchange bid/ask for the majors

description: utilpeek: Use when an agent needs on-chain EUR/GBP/MXN/BRL/CAD/SGD/ZAR/IDR vs USD or exchange quotes for 8 pairs, not ECB. For the ECB fix or a past date use get_fx_rates. Returns on-chain FX bid/ask/mid with ECB deviation_pct; indicative quotes from a regulated exchange for EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, AUDUSD, USDCAD, USDCHF, EURGBP, EURJPY (`exchange_quotes`). USDCHF/EURGBP/EURJPY exchange-only; USDCAD also on-chain. Matching gap_pct in exchange_gaps. Indicative, not dealable or synchronized arbitrage. Pools cached 15 s; `thin`/`errors` reported. Exchange cache 60 s; stale=true data kept at most 300 s. as_of/age_s: fetch age, not venue age; venue_timestamp null. Exchange-only empty: 503 exchange_unavailable (not charged). Unknown pair: 422 (not charged). Typically 2 to 4 s (two chain reads). Price: USD 0.002. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/live-fx-rates-api.html

amount_usd.description: Reference trade size in USD for the price-impact measurement, 100 to 100000 (default 1000). A pair whose impact at this size is 1% or more is listed under `thin`.

pairs.description: Pairs in market convention, for example EURUSD (USD per EUR) or USDMXN (MXN per USD). Omit for every supported pair. Exchange quotes cover EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, AUDUSD, USDCAD, USDCHF, EURGBP and EURJPY. USDJPY, AUDUSD, USDCHF, EURGBP and EURJPY are exchange-only; EURUSD, GBPUSD and USDCAD also have configured on-chain pools. An unknown pair is a 422 that lists the supported ones.

name: get_live_fx_rates

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
